import_provenance.original_title: Deciding the two-quantifier theory of c.e. degrees
import_provenance.original_statement: Is the ∀∃ fragment of the first-order theory of computably enumerable Turing degrees decidable in the language containing only the ordering relation? Harrington–Shelah proved the full theory undecidable, but locating the exact boundary between decidable and undecidable fragments remains open.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial continuation of their undecidability theorem. Adding join or meet operations changes the question and can make the two-quantifier fragment undecidable.
